text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "If your department’s head translator cannot put you in touch with a translator, you can contact the Federal Chancellery, which maintains a list of qualified external translators.", "gist": "Contact the Federal Chancellery for translator referrals if your department's head translator cannot assist."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Chancellery", "gist": "The Federal Chancellery"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Ordinance on the Federal Administration Language Services", "gist": "A specific ordinance governing language services in the Federal Administration"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Chancellery instructions on the provision of language services (in German, French and Italian)", "gist": "Instructions from the Federal Chancellery on language service provision, available in three languages"}]}
